content: अलोक {%a.%} .²1 Not having space (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²2 That which cannot be seen, as in लोकालोक इवाचलः <ls>R. 1. 68</ls> (न लोक्यत इत्यलोकः <ls>Malli.</ls>); see लोकालोक also. .²3 Having no people. .²4 One who does not go to any other world after death (not having performed meritorious deeds). .²5 Beyond space (लोकातीत परब्रह्म); पश्यतां सर्वलोकानामलोकं समपद्यत <ls>Bhāg. 6. 12. 35</ls>. .{@-कः, -कम्@} .²1 Not the world. .²2 End of, destruction of the world; absence of people; रक्ष सर्वानिमाँल्लोकान् नालोकं कर्तुमर्हसि <ls>Rām.</ls> .²3 The immaterial or spiritual world. .²4 The nether world (पाताल). .²5 A {%Ritvij%} or any such priest. .²6 One who is not a seer or observer. .{@-का@} A kind of bird.
